description: List current and recent cricket matches (Test/ODI/T20) with live scores, teams, venue, and status. Use this for "what cricket matches are live/on right now". Returns match IDs usable with match_info.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own CricAPI key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

offset.description: Pagination offset (default 0). Each page returns up to 25 matches.

name: current_matches
title: Current Matches
